parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside in test targets: `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/NowPlayingServiceTests.swift` and `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift`. The shared name `MockArtworkService` in both files is a classic test-fixture pattern where each test suite defines its own local mock to remain self-contained and avoid coupling test packages to one another. Consolidating these mocks would introduce a cross-package test dependency that is harder to maintain and violates test isolation principles. Per the decision rules, any cluster containing a test-marked record warrants no-action.
